title: Zesty Crisp Mediterranean Cannellini Bean Salad
description: A peppery and crisp Mediterranean dish featuring cannellini beans, this salad is a nostalgic and flavorful treat, perfect for a low-carb diet. It combines the freshness of steam-cooked vegetables with the richness of cannellini beans.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the cannellini beans, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, and kalamata olives.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and pepper to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the bean mixture and toss to coat.
Sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top of the salad and toss again to combine.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, give the salad a good stir and adjust the seasoning if necessary.
Serve the salad chilled, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
This salad can be made ahead of time and stored in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
Before serving, give the salad a good stir and add any additional ingredients, such as crumbled feta cheese or sliced grilled chicken.
